entities.summary: The Tozai Line, formally the Hanshin Kobe Kosoku Line, is one of three lines of the Kobe Rapid Transit Railway, operated by Hanshin Railway and Hankyu Railway. Trains from Hanshin, Hankyu and Sanyo railways enter this line.
